Welcome to Healing Touch Dental PMS

This application stores patient and clinical information locally in this browser/device unless an external service is explicitly configured. Regular encrypted backups are strongly recommended.

Data lives only in this browser profile. Clearing browser data, switching devices, or using a different browser will not show your records unless you restore from a backup.
